raw_statement: CSR Notes: Insured Travis Bellamy calling to file collision claim on 2020 Mercedes-Benz C300 4MATIC (black, license GA-RTX-2204, VIN W1KWF8DB2LR598217, mileage 68,700). Incident occurred late Wednesday night/early Thursday morning (Sept 23, 2026) around 3:30 AM on Peachtree Industrial Blvd near Winters Chapel Rd in Doraville. Insured's recorded statement: 'I was heading home from seeing a buddy and the road was totally deserted. A massive deer darted straight out of the brush into my headlights. I reflexively whipped the wheel to the right to avoid killing it, lost traction, and slid down into a deep drainage ditch along the embankment. The nose of the car slammed into the opposite dirt bank with tremendous force. The front bumper assembly got ripped completely off, the hood is folded back, both multibeam LED headlights got crushed into the frame, and the radiator, condenser, and engine oil pan are all smashed and leaking black synthetic oil and coolant into the dirt. The right front suspension is snapped or bent inward because the front right tire is sitting at a 45-degree crooked angle against the wheel well. Vehicle was 100% immobilized and wouldn't crank. I sat there in shock for half an hour until a roadside tow company dragged it out on a winch.' When asked if police or animal control were dispatched: Insured says 'No, the deer took off into the woods untouched, nobody else was involved, and I was exhausted so I just hitched a ride with the tow truck driver.' Injuries: Complaining of dull lower lumbar back pain from the ditch impact; states he might go to urgent care if it doesn't improve.
